I read the draft sentence by sentence.

- **"Black tea, orange peel, cinnamon and a little clove."**: This lists ingredients, which are product facts that are fine to use as written. It makes no health or flavour-effect claim.
- **"It's back in the shop from today."**: This states when the product is available. It isn't a countdown, a stock claim or "today only" pressure, so it isn't false urgency.
- **Labels:** This is the brand's own newsletter, so it needs no ad label. There are no affiliate links or creator content.
- **Voice:** It's warm, plain and unhurried, in UK spelling. It uses none of the banned words or AI clichés.
